notes: Focused Feed video exposes an explicit common fullscreen action, pauses the inline renderer while the overlay is active, transfers the current playback position into the overlay, and restores the updated position when returning to the same detail.

Position transfer is applied only when a renderer becomes active. Android, Web and iOS do not seek on playback ticks or mute changes, and zero is preserved as a valid rewind position while negative values are rejected.

Web/Wasm, Android and iOS opened and closed the Feed video viewer on the exact Product SHA, returned to the same detail and completed the existing Official detail route. The fixture used a real temporary MP4 plus PNG and finished with database and Storage residue absent.

The first iOS attempts remain preserved in local evidence history. They showed that the fullscreen action overlapped the right-side LIVE rail and exposed only eight hittable pixels. Moving the 44-pixel action to the top center removed the overlap; the accepted exact-SHA run then passed without changing video, signature or product semantics.

The native iOS XCTest independently verifies positive-position and zero-position handoff across deactivation/reactivation. It does not replace the platform UI postflight, which verifies the real fullscreen open, close and detail return.

This reduction closes only Feed video-viewer entry, return and playback-position continuity inside OVR-POST-DETAIL. It does not claim exhaustive codec coverage, network errors, download/share, background playback, other media origins, comments integration, deep scroll restoration or public-profile video detail.

Raw reports, screenshots, host paths, simulator identifiers and fixture identifiers remain unversioned. The committed reports are sanitized projections containing only SHA binding, required steps and zero-residue cleanup counts.

Any executable, workflow, runner, source, resource, test, configuration or dependency change after productSha invalidates affected evidence; attestation-only documentation remains subject to scripts/validate-candidate-attestation.mjs.
